serving_temperature_items.item_ja: 冷たい食べ物や飲み物

notes:
84 rows. Layout: the article gives (1) a 五性 primer with example foods per class (L49-58), (2) four 見分け方 heuristics with example foods (L66-82), (3) a four-block 温める/冷やす/どちらでもない list (L83-112), (4) a hot-pot section (L118-134), (5) recipe notes (L135-148), (6) a 'cooling ways of eating' section (L149-158). All coded rows come from an explicit 五性 label (熱性/温性/平性/涼性/寒性) or an explicit 体を温める/体を冷やす/どちらでもない statement.

BOTH-DIRECTION foods (recorded twice, as instructed):
- さつまいも: warm at L69 (地中で育つ食材は体を温めるものが多い…さつまいもなどが当てはまります) but どちらでもない (neutral) at L90 in the main vegetable list. The source contradicts itself; both rows kept.
- 唐辛子: warm at L50 (熱性) but '食べすぎると逆に冷える場合も' at L141 (conditional cooling via カプサイシン発汗型). The L141 row is condition-bound; an adjudicator may prefer to drop it as a caveat rather than a nature attribution.

DUPLICATE VERBATIM FORMS (same food, two labels — kept as separate rows so coverage comparison is not distorted; collapse to one key at aggregation):
- ねぎ (L52, L130 「ねぎやにらは温性の野菜です」, L140, L177) vs 長ねぎ (L86) — both warm.
- ごぼう (L70) vs ゴボウ (L88) — both cool.
- きのこ (L146 「きのこ（平性）」) vs きのこ類 (L90) — both neutral.
- 大豆 appears at L54 (平性 example) and again at L76-77 (大豆 → 平性) — one row only, same direction.

STRUCTURAL ROW HEADERS — NOT CODED: 「温める食材：」「冷やす食材：」「どちらでもない：」 are the direction labels of the four-block list (L85/87/89, 92/94/96, 100/102/104, 107/109) and repeat under every block; they are not foods. Block headings 野菜・きのこ / 肉・魚介 / 発酵食品・調味料 / 果物・ナッツ (L84, 91, 99, 106) carry no direction of their own.

根菜類 — NOT CODED (appears on both sides): the heading L68 is 「地中で育つもの（根菜類の一部）」 (explicitly only 一部), L69 assigns warming to 地面の下で育つ食材, but L70 says 「根菜類でも大根やごぼうは薬膳では涼性に分類される」. L137/L143 refer only to 「温性の根菜」= にんじん・かぶ. The umbrella 根菜類 is therefore split across both directions and is treated as structural.

暖色系の食材 (L72, warm) / 寒色系の食材 (L73, cool) — NOT CODED, flagged for adjudication: these are colour-based identification heuristics, not food categories like 根菜類/海藻. Their example foods (にんじん、かぼちゃ、鮭、エビ、赤身肉) ARE coded; L73 names no foods.

§8 EXCLUSIONS (substitute recommendation, no nature attribution):
- 黒糖 (L156 「甘みを加えたいときは、はちみつや黒糖を使う方が温活にはプラスです」) — dropped, matching the previous round's precedent for this exact source. (はちみつ is coded neutral, but from the explicit どちらでもない list at L105, not from this sentence.)
- 温野菜 / 蒸し野菜 (L151 「サラダよりも温野菜や蒸し野菜にするのがおすすめです」) — recommendation about cooking state, no 五性 attribution.

DIT BLOCK — NOT CODED: L126 (鶏肉、鮭、エビ、豚肉などのタンパク質は食事誘発性熱産生（DIT）が高く) and L162-169 (タンパク質 約30% / 糖質 約6% / 脂質 約4%; 鶏肉、魚、卵、大豆製品) describe diet-induced thermogenesis, a nutritional mechanism, not the food's 五性 nature. Coding these would directly contradict the source's own 平性 labels for 卵 (L54, L97) and どちらでもない for 豚肉 (L97). タンパク質/糖質/脂質 are macronutrients, not foods.

BORDERLINE, NOT CODED: 甘酒 (L144 「甘酒と同じ米麹由来の発酵パワーが体の芯からぽかぽかにしてくれます」) — the warming is predicated of 酒粕's fermentation power, described as the same origin as 甘酒's; no direction is predicated of 甘酒 itself. Flagged in case the adjudicator reads it as an attribution.

QUESTION HEADING, NOT AN ATTRIBUTION: L8 「大根は冬野菜だから温まるんじゃないの？」 is the reader-persona's question; the source answers it with cool at L10, which is what is coded.

NO DIRECTION GIVEN: カプサイシン/ピペリン/わさび/山椒 in the related-article blurb at L189 (no direction stated there; 山椒 is coded warm from L50 only). 唐辛子（血行促進） at L140 states a mechanism, not a 五性 class.

SERVING TEMPERATURE: L12 「温かい料理＝体が温まる」とは限りません is the article's framing thesis; L157-158 冷たいもの全般 / 冷たい食べ物や飲み物は内臓を直接冷やします / 常温以上の食事. All filed as serving-temperature items, not foods.
